worldcombat.skill.punishment.summary: Punishes an empowered target with a close-range strike. Positive stat stages and potion/beacon buffs make it hit harder.
worldcombat.skill.punishment.use.0: Hit hard when the foe has stacked stat stages
worldcombat.skill.punishment.use.1: Weigh every layer the target has raised into the damage
worldcombat.skill.punishment.use.2: An overhead judgement that falls from above
worldcombat.skill.punishment.description: One blow dealing about %1$s contact damage at about %2$s blocks; each positive stat stage on the target adds 18 (capped at +150).
worldcombat.skill.punishment.heavy.on: Heavy judgement: each positive stat stage is worth x1.35 and reach +0.2, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up, +2 of recovery and +5 of cooldown - hardest on a fully buffed foe.
worldcombat.skill.punishment.heavy.off: Quick judgement: faster wind-up and cycle but a lower per-stage coefficient - good against lightly buffed frail targets.
worldcombat.skill.punishment.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.punishment.growth.0: At level %1$s the judgement power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.punishment.growth.1: At level %1$s the judgement power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
On (heavy): each positive stat stage is worth x1.35 and reach +0.2, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up, +2 of recovery and +5 of cooldown. Off (quick): faster wind-up and cycle but a lower coefficient. Each direction has its moment: heavy against a fully buffed tank, quick against a lightly buffed frail target.
worldcombat.skill.punishment.world: All seven positive stat stages and potion/beacon buffs count, with level I counting once. Each level adds 18 power, capped at 150 extra power. The target keeps its buffs after being hit.
